# NanoTrasen Created by the merger between the mining company Nanobit, and the pioneer in medical research TrasenTek, NanoTrasen seeks to provide the galaxy with technology that eases the daily burdens of life and make the universe a safer place. Unless you have been working in a sector uninhabited by NanoTrasen, you would have seen our products by now and even use them in your daily lives. The health analyzer was developed by TrasenTek for the purpose of rapid diagnoses for patients leading to immediate treatments and a monumental increase in lives being saved during emergencies.
Working on our stations will be one of the most rewarding experiences in your life. Your contract and all benefits are now active while you work with us.
